mainEntity.name: What should I do if my fridge stops working at home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Check it is plugged in and the door is closing fully, and look for a tripped switch. Keep the doors shut, move meat and dairy into a cooler with ice if it is warm, and note the brand, model and any error code before you call.
